info.title: SmartStock API
info.description:
JSON API for SmartStock, the three-tier vending stock dashboard for Adlers (BFB 321, Group 25).

**Logging in.** The API uses the same session as the web pages. 1) `GET /auth/csrf` to get a token and a session cookie. 2) `POST /auth/login` with the token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header. Keep the cookie for later requests.

**Changes** (POST, PUT, PATCH) always need the `X-CSRF-Token` header. Reads (GET) do not.

**Roles.** `user` (Mr Msiza and his helpers) can view everything and change stock. `admin` can also manage accounts.

**Lists** are paged (`page`, `per_page` up to 100), sorted with `sort=key` or `sort=-key`, and filtered with the parameters listed per endpoint.

**Errors** always look like `{"error": {"status": 400, "message": "...", "field": "qty"}}`.

All data in the demo database is synthetic.

get.description: Call this first. It starts a session (cookie) and returns the token to send in the X-CSRF-Token header.

post.description: Logs in with email and password. The session cookie identifies you afterwards.

get.description: The logged-in user, their permissions and the CSRF token.
KPIs, the 5 most urgent alerts, the order summary, best sellers and the sales window.
Paged list of machines with their open alert count.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text in the machine code or location (not case-sensitive).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; a leading minus sorts high to low.

get.summary: One machine with all three stock tiers
get.description: Objective O2: machine, drawer and central stock side by side for every product the machine carries.

put.description: A physical count of one product inside the machine (the manual fallback for the sensor feed). Audited.

post.description: The units fill the machine first, then top up the drawer to the allocation recommendation; the rest goes back to central storage. Every change is audited.

get.description: Objective O3: products ranked by 30-day turnover and the recommended drawer buffer for each.
Paged list of the shared stock pool at the Adlers facility.

schema.description: A page of central storage rows.

parameters.name: low_only
parameters.description: true: only products at or below their threshold.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; a leading minus sorts high to low.

put.description: Sets the counted quantity of one product in central storage. Audited.

200.description: The product's new central storage row.

get.description: Every stock row in any tier at or below its threshold; out of stock first.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: out: only qty 0; low: only qty above 0.

get.description: Every change to any tier, newest first, with who made it. Paged in the database.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Up to and including this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.description: Objective O4: one order per supplier, built from the stock in all three tiers and 30-day demand.

post.description: Admin only. There is no public registration.

patch.summary: Change role or switch an account on/off
patch.description: Admin only. An admin cannot change their own role or switch themselves off, and one active admin always remains.

put.summary: Set a new password for an account
put.description: Admin only, for someone who forgot theirs.

get.description: The OpenAPI document you are reading.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input. `field` names the bad parameter or body field. Also returned when the CSRF token is missing or wrong.

Unauthorized.description: Not logged in (or wrong email/password on login).

Forbidden.description: Logged in, but the role does not allow this (e.g. a user calling an admin endpoint).

NotFound.description: The machine, product or user does not exist, or the machine does not carry that product.

Conflict.description: The change clashes with existing data (duplicate email, changing your own role, removing the last admin).

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

message.description: What went wrong, written for a person.

field.description: The request field or query parameter that was wrong (only for input errors).

Error.description: Every error response has this shape.

Page.description: One page of a list. The `items` type depends on the endpoint.

total.description: Items across all pages, after filtering.

capacity.description: Most units the slot holds; null for central storage.

threshold.description: Alert when qty is at or below this.

csrf_token.description: Send this in the X-CSRF-Token header on every POST, PUT and PATCH.

alerts.description: Open low-stock alerts for this machine (machine and drawer tiers).

MachineStockRow.description: One product in one machine, with all three stock tiers side by side.

split.description: Where the units went: machine first, then the drawer, the rest back to central storage.

buffer_days.description: Days of sales the drawer should cover.

Movement.description: One entry in the audit trail.

urgent.description: On hand is at or below the reorder point.

trips_saved.description: Trips saved by ordering per supplier instead of per product.

baseline_trips.description: Unplanned supplier trips a week before SmartStock (proposal).

baseline_hours.description: Driving hours a month at baseline.

target_hours_saved.description: Hours a month saved at the O4 target.

sales_window.description: The 30-day window the numbers use; null with no sales.
